text:
maria_sales: Heads-up  medtech PO wants a 2-week POC pinned to Canada + Brazil. Requirements: 95th <200ms, and full subprocessor list. Need quick ballpark + blockers.

raj_presales: Can we phase CA-first? that may reduce cost and speed delivery.

samir_sre: ca-central1 hosted can hit latency. sa-east1 hosted is limited and cannot guarantee "no copies" due to backups/metrics. For absolute residency we need Dedicated or Private.

anya_security: PHI risk flagged. BYOK helps with keys but not metadata/replication. If questionnaire says "no copies outside country" hosted multi-tenant is insufficient. Security will assemble subproc manifest (hosted vs dedicated).

ops_ashley: I can check quota today. rough ballpark for 2x A10G-equivalent reserved pool per region for 14d: ~$12k-$16k/region (placeholder). Timeline: quota today, pricing tomorrow AM, provisioning 48-72h after PO+legal. Blockers: legal signoff on subproc list and budget.

maria_sales: I'll tell customer: propose CA-first or dual dedicated; BYOK alone won't meet the no-copy ask; will follow up with subproc list and firm quote. Thanks :thumbsup:
